verdict_reason: S1+S2 fully open via GEE, no application needed. Conditional because optical duty-cycle is severely constrained (annual mean cloud amount 84.6%, NASA POWER climatology) which 4-class typing likely needs for greenhouse/bare-soil discrimination; and no Malaysian source labels mechanism classes -- must hand-construct with no way to cross-check accuracy.

ground_truth.construction_protocol: Analyst visually types each SAR-flagged change patch (terrace/road/greenhouse/non-farm) from paired pre/post Sentinel-2 best-available cloud-free date plus a high-res basemap; no district enforcement or permit record exists to seed or cross-check labels.

compute_path.platform: Google Earth Engine (COPERNICUS/S1_GRD + COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED) for feature extraction; Colab free tier or Kaggle free GPU for the patch classifier
compute_path.why: Both imagery sources are free GEE catalog collections; a small SAR+optical patch classifier fits Colab/Kaggle free GPU, no sustained local CUDA needed.
